summary: Batch certification of nine Fourth Way exploration maps (explorations/grades-to-maximum-at-being.toml, more-in-strict-degree.toml, bearers-degree-directed.toml, greatest-degree-causes-all.toml, maximum-in-genus-causes-all.toml, being-graded-by-approach.toml, more-such-has-perfection.toml, as-to-being-so-to-truth.toml, god-is-maximal-in-being.toml): twelve zero-axiom derivations in TruthCore/Results/Causality/Round3FourthWay. Grades to a maximum at being follows either from an ascent bound (well-founded induction, Lean WellFounded) or from the approach order with strict primacy. Strict calibration among bearers follows from the approach order and the q.3 a.5 ad 2 'as much as it approaches' match; directedness from comparability or from a greatest bearer. The greatest-degree genus principle follows from the approach order with q.13 a.5 (the greatest bearer is the primary) and, separately, from the stronger maximal principle under calibration; the maximal principle follows from the every-genus greatest-degree principle plus directed degrees and the bearer calibration, answering ATTEMPT-REJECTED-DERIVATION-LEADS-20261107 for that target now that bare premises are allowed. More-such-has-the-perfection follows through degrees above a null degree; as-to-being-so-to-truth through intelligibility (q.16); the approach order itself from a global calibration and the q.3 a.5 ad 2 match; God is maximal in being through God as the primary of being. Controls: 31 hand-written omission models (scripts/countermodel.py does not take the Preorder parameter; one infinite model on Nat for the ascent bound) and one joint Boolean witness, all zero-axiom. Rejected edges: ATTEMPT-ROUND3-FOURTH-WAY-REJECTED-EDGES.
blocker: Every new premise is open. Supported (claim bears on it, gap noted): God is the primary of being and degree as much as approach (q.3 a.5 ad 2, which denies a proportioned measure, so a Preorder-valued degree is the analyst's), truth of things is intelligibility (q.16 a.1), intelligibility proportioned to being (q.16 a.3), greatest-degree principle in every genus (q.2 a.3). Bare analyst premises: the per-respect degree calibrations (more-in exceeds degree; degree excess among bearers is more-in; global match), no degree below null, above null has the perfection, no infinite ascent in being, bearer degrees comparable, some bearer greatest, bearer degrees directed in every genus, grades found in being. Several edges relate premises in both directions (approach order <-> calibration; maximal <-> greatest principle) through different calibration statements; global cycles are allowed and no argument is circular.
